name: debug
description: Optional debug systems: collider/sprite overlays, screenshot capture, scripted pointer replay, and per-system frame-time profiling
postInstallNotes:
## debug installed

Add whichever you need to your pipeline:

- `ColliderDebugSystem(world, camera)` — draws AABB / SAT outlines after rendering.
- `SpriteDebugSystem(world, camera)` — draws sprite bounds and pivot points.
- `ScreenshotCaptureSystem(graphicsDevice, intervalSeconds, debugDir, format, maxFrames)` — frame capture: PNG (occasional verification shots) or raw RGBA (full-rate 60 fps takes). Env-driven runs use `ScreenshotCaptureSystem.FromEnvironment(...)` — the single owner of the `MONODREAMS_SCREENSHOT` / `_INTERVAL` / `_MAX_FRAMES` contract (see `docs/overview.md` § Frame capture). The replay-gated pattern (`"screenshots": true` in `debug/input_replay.json`) still works for PNG-interval capture.
- `PointerReplaySystem.TryLoad(debugDir, world, camera, viewportManager, requestExit)` — scripted mouse replay (`debug/pointer_replay.json`: move / click / wheel / type / waitUntil / label). Returns `null` without the file, so a normal run is unaffected. Register it right after `CursorInputSystem` and stand the hardware path down (`cursorInput.SkipHardwareRead = true`, `cursorPosition.SkipDerivation = true`) — this is why the module depends on `cursor`. Pass the screen's `ViewportManager` so the authored virtual point also lands in `ScreenPosition`'s backbuffer-pixel space. See `docs/overview.md` § Pointer replay.

**Per-system profiling (`SystemProfiler`).** Not a pipeline system — a static that plugs into `foundation`'s socket. Wire it in the host:

1. At boot, `SystemProfiler.Enabled = PlatformServices.Current.GetEnvironmentVariable("MONODREAMS_PROFILE") == "1";` — the setter installs `SystemProfiler.Record` as `GatedSystem.TimingSink`, so with the env var unset nothing is installed and the cost is one null check per gated system per frame.
2. In the host's `Update` loop, `SystemProfiler.CountFrame();` then `SystemProfiler.ReportPeriodically(state, ref timer);` (a `float` field on the host; the interval is `SystemProfiler.ReportInterval`, 2s by default).

Every gate a screen registers through `EditorPipelineRegistrar` carries the entry's full hierarchical registration name, so report rows read `logic.game` / `logic.game.enemies` — groups nest under their own total. Reports go through `Logger`, which reaches the browser console on a web head.

**Replay testing.** `Logger` and the replay scaffold live in `foundation` because they're useful in production. This module adds the *visual* debug overlays and the profiler — they're safe to ship in dev builds and exclude in release.

See `docs/premises.md` for the module's invariants and `docs/overview.md` for the full tour.
